# The refund desk with the stand-ins for the system of record, the chat service and the mail agent. The command is obeereal, the real composition root.
# One email asks for a refund of 80, which is under the limit of 100. The clerk proposes it, the desk checks the proposal against the policy and the live
# system, approves it by policy, and runs the saga: a credit with its read-back, then the reply. The case closes and the shift closes.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:sha256sum] [!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

deskinit
deskfakes
subst home/.desk/config
env HOME=$WORK/home
env DESK_DIR=$WORK/desk

exec obeereal check workflow desk/workflow.star
! stdout .
! stderr .
exec obeereal check workflow desk/eval.star
! stdout .
! stderr .

exec obeereal item add desk shift-1 --title 'Morning shift' --body-file body.txt
stdout 'added item shift-1 to project desk'

exec obeereal run shift-1 desk --workflow desk/workflow.star
stdout 'item shift-1 finished'

# The clerk ran once. The mask kept the address and the name out of its prompt.
cmp calls.log expected-calls.log
grep 'M_EMAIL_' last-prompt.txt
! grep 'ann@example.com' last-prompt.txt
! grep 'Ann Smith' last-prompt.txt

# The credit was written once, with the key of the engine, and read back. The reply went out once, to the real address.
grep -count=1 '^credit-' writes.log
! grep 'uncredit' writes.log
grep -count=1 'ann@example.com' mail.out
grep 'We refund 80 EUR for BK-123456' mail.out

# The mail moved to the folder cur, so a second shift finds no new message.
! exists home/.desk/mail/new/m1
exists home/.desk/mail/cur/m1

exec obeereal status
stdout 'shift-1-r1\tdone'
stdout 'desk-2-r1\tdone'

-- body.txt --
The morning shift.
-- expected-calls.log --
clerk
-- home/.desk/config --
DESK_API=http://desk.test
MAILDIR=@WORK@/home/.desk/mail
CHAT_SPOOL=@WORK@/home/.desk/chat
CHAT_API=http://chat.test
MASK_SALT=testsalt
-- home/.desk/credential.header --
Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY
-- home/.desk/mail/cur/keep --
-- home/.desk/chat/keep --
-- home/.desk/mail/new/m1 --
Message-Id: <m1@mail.test>
From: Ann Smith <ann@example.com>
Subject: Refund BK-123456

Thanks, Ann Smith. Please refund 80 for BK-123456.
-- resp/_bookings_BK-123456 --
{"ref":"BK-123456","status":"cancelled","paid":120,"currency":"EUR","date":"2026-12-01","customer_name":"Ann Smith","customer_email":"ann@example.com","refunded":0}
-- resp/_eligibility_refund --
{"eligible":true}
